plugins.name: keel
plugins.description: Turn coding agents into work owners. A vendor-neutral backbone that takes a GitHub issue to a merged PR: readiness check, isolated worktree, multi-agent review, CI and evidence gates, merge window. Claude Code, Codex, Cursor (partial), Antigravity.

plugins.name: keel-progress
plugins.description: Optional Claude Code mod: shows the live keel run above the prompt and in a /keel-progress pane, read from `keel status --json`. Read-only; needs Claude Code 2.1.287+ with mods enabled.
